# The SoapBox Ecosystem

> A free public library and toolset from the Shaivite Temple: plant-medicine and harm-reduction reference, a benefits navigator that names the free path, consciousness research, the MELEK chain, and community tools. Everything is published free, without membership, paywall or registration.

Site: https://soapbox.community
